grades.quote: disks provide their fastest performance when asked to access a large number of consecutive sectors in a single request at a location nearby to the previous access request.
grades.reason: States that disk speed depends on how many consecutive sectors are requested and on how near the access is to the previous one. This implies that the same-sized read can be fast or slow depending on head position and location. It doesn't name seek time or rotational latency.
